import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

frames.title: Step 4: Set up the Fourier grid
frames.logic: I calculate wave numbers consistent with the grid spacing and periodic domain. k2 denotes the squared magnitude of a wave vector. The denominator contains the term treated implicitly in the original update. The zero Fourier mode represents the spatial mean.
frames.code:
out = Path(output)
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
n = 128
x = 2 * np.pi * np.arange(n) / n
k = 2 * np.pi * np.fft.fftfreq(n, d=2 * np.pi / n)
c0 = 1 + 0.4 * np.cos(x) + 0.2 * np.cos(4 * x)
rows = []

frames.title: Step 5: Repeat the operation and inspect each case
frames.logic: I repeat the operation over the specified cases. Read the loop variable first, then follow what changes on each pass. The assertions check the stated numerical or topological condition.
frames.code:
for t in [0, 0.02, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0]:
    c = np.fft.ifft(np.fft.fft(c0) * np.exp(-k * k * t)).real
    exact = 1 + 0.4 * np.exp(-t) * np.cos(x) + 0.2 * np.exp(-16 * t) * np.cos(4 * x)
    rows.append([t, c.mean(), np.max(np.abs(c - exact))])
    np.savetxt(out / f'profile_{t:.2f}.csv', np.column_stack([x, c]), delimiter=',')

frames.title: Step 6: My check of this result
frames.logic: I check finite values, conservation or the known reference result as specified below. An assertion stops the notebook if the condition fails. Inspect the quantities and tolerance rather than suppressing a failure.
frames.code:
np.savetxt(out / 'diagnostics.csv', rows, delimiter=',', header='time,mean,max_exact_error', comments='')
assert max((r[2] for r in rows)) < 1e-12
print('Fourier diffusion: max exact error', max((r[2] for r in rows)))

frames.title: Plot and interpret the result
frames.logic: I compare the profiles at the saved times. The rapidly varying mode fades first, while the mean remains 1. The horizontal coordinate and concentration are dimensionless.
frames.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
for t in (0, .02, .1, .3, 1.):
    profile = np.loadtxt(out / f"profile_{t:.2f}.csv", delimiter=",")
    ax.plot(profile[:, 0], profile[:, 1], label=f"t={t}")
ax.set_xlabel("Dimensionless position x")
ax.set_ylabel("Dimensionless concentration c")
ax.legend()
plt.show()
